verdict.rationale: PayPal documents an official MCP server, both local (`npx @paypal/mcp`) and remotely hosted (mcp.paypal.com), that lets merchants run PayPal using natural language from MCP clients and Anthropic/OpenAI LLMs. Its tool inventory spans the merchant back office: invoices, orders, refunds, disputes, subscriptions, catalog, shipment tracking and insights, and each tool comes with a sample prompt. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language operation works reliably, and a native first-party natural-language interface (it requires an external MCP client or agent, and remote commerce tools are feature-flagged and limited to gift cards).
